explication: Scalable CLI is a Rust command-line client for Scalable Broker, supporting interactive and JSON automation. The main workflow is command selection, authenticated session loading, broker query execution and projection, then structured or human-readable output. Trading and savings-plan changes add a distinct preview, confirmation, and submission flow. The graph includes documented broker, market-data, account, and trading capabilities; edges are limited to README statements and source-index references. Several feature modules were not sampled, so their internal call relationships are not asserted.
